name: @mrquake/quakecode-cli
description: Quake Code is a terminal-first coding assistant with sessions, file tools, shell tools, skills, themes, and multi-provider support.

scripts.build: tsgo -p tsconfig.build.json && npx shx chmod +x dist/cli.js && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build:binary: npm --prefix ../tui run build && npm --prefix ../ai run build && npm --prefix ../agent run build && npm run build && bun build --compile ./dist/bun/cli.js --outfile dist/quake-code && npm run copy-binary-assets
scripts.copy-assets: npx shx mkdir -p dist/modes/interactive/theme && npx shx cp src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json dist/modes/interactive/theme/ && npx shx mkdir -p dist/core/export-html/vendor && npx shx cp src/core/export-html/template.html src/core/export-html/template.css src/core/export-html/template.js dist/core/export-html/ && npx shx cp src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/core/export-html/vendor/ && npx shx mkdir -p dist/bundled && npx shx cp -r src/bundled/* dist/bundled/
scripts.copy-binary-assets: npx shx cp package.json dist/ && npx shx cp README.md dist/ && npx shx cp CHANGELOG.md dist/ && npx shx cp NOTICE dist/ && npx shx mkdir -p dist/theme && npx shx cp src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json dist/theme/ && npx shx mkdir -p dist/export-html/vendor && npx shx cp src/core/export-html/template.html dist/export-html/ && npx shx cp src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/export-html/vendor/ && npx shx mkdir -p dist/bundled && npx shx cp -r src/bundled/* dist/bundled/ && npx shx cp -r docs dist/ && npx shx cp -r examples dist/ && npx shx cp ../../node_modules/@silvia-odwyer/photon-node/photon_rs_bg.wasm dist/
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build

author: MrQuake
